entries.06677bd050f457e9: As a [[term:holding-company|holding company]], it manages the group companies and performs business incidental to that. The group consists of the company, 82 consolidated subsidiaries, 4 unconsolidated subsidiaries not accounted for under the equity method, 4 affiliates accounted for under the equity method, and 2 affiliates not accounted for under the equity method, and as a general wholesaler that handles everything from the upstream to the downstream of the supply chain, it describes itself as a "total supporter of distribution." Its reportable segments are three: the food-related business, the sugar powder and feed and livestock-related business, and the housing and real estate-related business.

Demand from domestic tourists and inbound visitors was strong, demand for souvenirs and food service remained firm, and sales increased. For rice and grains, although the average in-store price per 5 kg of rice has been trending downward since February 2026, it remains at a high level, and the company gives priority to securing raw materials and works to ensure stable supply. Revenue for this segment alone is not printed.

entries.2bf3515b1a8d8138: This segment handles feed, livestock products and similar goods. As grain and feed prices are unstable due to exchange rates, crude oil and international conditions, the company is working to increase its share with existing customers and win new customers by leveraging functions such as technical guidance and management support. In the egg business, prices remain high due to soaring imported feed costs, rising electricity charges for poultry houses and avian influenza infections, and the company is thoroughly implementing disease prevention and quality control to secure stable supply. Revenue for this segment alone is not printed.
entries.2f744658a4efb582: This segment is not included in the reportable segments and includes the fuel-related business, car rental business, transportation business, information processing services business and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥19,890 million (down 15.4% year on year), accounting for 1.8% of consolidated revenue. The reason for the revenue decline is not stated. In the transportation business, amid continued labor shortages and soaring crude oil prices, the company is working to improve efficiency by sharing and utilizing logistics resources within the group. In the car rental business, while the industry as a whole is growing on inbound demand, new entrants have increased and price competition has intensified, and the company is securing profit by raising utilization rates and improving unit prices. The principal affiliated companies listed are Yamae Auto Energy Co., Ltd., Takachiho Soko Unyu Co., Ltd. and Kyushu Eiko Express Co., Ltd.

entries.696bf5c488fb719f: As the "total supporter of distribution," it states that it aims to create business and achieve sustainable growth in every situation from the upstream to the downstream of the supply chain. Under the new medium-term management plan "Create“ONE”28," covering the fiscal years 2026 to 2028, it sets four basic strategies: M&A strategy, global strategy, area and logistics strategy, and new business strategy, and aims for consolidated net sales of ¥1.5 trillion for the fiscal year ending March 2029. It plans to expand growth investments in M&A and new businesses, as well as efficiency investments such as capital expenditure and AX and DX investments.

entries.746c4fb8e0bc4b05: This business sells food ingredients, feed, livestock products and marine products, and also engages in livestock farming. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,985 million (up 9.4% year on year), accounting for 11.7% of consolidated revenue. Demand from domestic tourists and inbound visitors was strong, demand for souvenirs and food service remained firm, and sales of food ingredients such as sugar, wheat flour and oils increased. In feed and livestock, amid unstable grain and feed prices, the company is working to increase its share with existing customers and win new customers through technical guidance and management support. The principal affiliated companies listed are Yamae Kuno Co., Ltd., Marunaga Co., Ltd., Top Egg Co., Ltd. and Baba Feed Co., Ltd.
entries.7842478e43798009: As the "total supporter of distribution," it states that it aims to create business and achieve sustainable growth in every situation from the upstream to the downstream of the supply chain.
entries.7b3112e99d5bc3b2: Its main business and the core of its net sales are the sale of foods and alcoholic beverages, food raw materials, feed, livestock and marine products, and housing materials and lumber. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,085,219 million, an increase of 7.8% over the same period of the previous year. Net sales to external customers were ¥839,047 million for the food-related business (77.3% of consolidated net sales), ¥126,985 million for the sugar powder and feed and livestock-related business (11.7%), ¥99,296 million for the housing and real estate-related business (9.2%), and ¥19,890 million for other businesses (1.8%). Most of the increase in net sales came from the food-related business, which resulted from firm demand mainly in the restaurant industry, as well as promotional activities, expansion of high value-added products, and efforts to improve the efficiency of logistics and manufacturing.

entries.9d8d31532d2ed95d: This business sells housing construction materials, housing equipment, lumber and similar products, and engages in construction work and real estate sales, purchases and leasing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥99,296 million (up 0.6% year on year), accounting for 9.2% of consolidated revenue. Results of subsidiaries including Fudosan no Osawa Co., Ltd., which joined the group in the previous fiscal year, were included for the full year. On the other hand, rising housing prices and higher mortgage rates reduced the purchase intentions of prospective homebuyers, and, owing to the 'rush of construction starts' ahead of the full enforcement in April 2025 of the revised Act on the Improvement of Energy Consumption Performance of Buildings and the revised Building Standards Act, the number of new housing starts has continued to decline since April of that year. The company is strengthening efforts to propose lumber and building materials together for properties for which it has received pre-cut orders. The principal affiliated companies listed are 11 companies, including Yamae Kuno Co., Ltd., Waitec Co., Ltd., Hibic Co., Ltd., Yamae Realty Co., Ltd., Astique Co., Ltd., Yamae BUILD Co., Ltd. and Kokoro Kensetsu Co., Ltd.

entries.c95490e76042dda4: This business centers on the sale of processed general foods, confectionery, alcoholic beverages and frozen foods, and also includes manufacture of boxed lunches and shochu, manufacture, processing and sale of agricultural and marine products, and delivery food services. It is the largest business in the group; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥839,047 million (up 9.2% year on year), accounting for 77.3% of consolidated revenue. Demand was firm mainly in the food service industry, and revenue increased as the company worked on sales promotion that captured changes in market structure and purchasing behavior, expanded high value-added products, and improved logistics and manufacturing efficiency. On the other hand, as food and beverage prices continued to rise, consumers became more inclined to save, and sales competition with peer companies has intensified. The principal affiliated companies listed number 15, including Yamae Kuno Co., Ltd., Minori Holdings Co., Ltd., Kawachiya Genos Co., Ltd., Confex Holdings Co., Ltd. and Nippon Pizza Hut Co., Ltd. Revenue broken down for this business alone is not printed, and the amounts that can be confirmed on the page are only those for the reportable segment.

entries.dda5fc8886a70f1d: The food-related business sells general processed foods, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, and frozen foods, and also manufactures boxed lunches and shochu, and processes and sells agricultural and marine products, and provides delivery dining services. The sugar powder and feed and livestock-related business sells food raw materials, feed, livestock products, and marine products, and also engages in livestock farming and related activities. The housing and real estate-related business sells housing construction materials, housing equipment and lumber, and engages in construction work and the sale and leasing of real estate. The "Other" category, which is not included in reportable segments, handles fuel, rental cars, transportation, and information processing services, among others.

entries.fe896708f92c42d3: [[term:net-income-attributable-to-owners-of-parent|Net income attributable to owners of parent]] for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,082 million, an increase of 29.8% over the same period of the previous year. Net sales and all profit items reached record highs. Amid downward factors such as intensifying competition in sales and soaring utility and logistics costs due to rising energy prices, the group worked on reviewing operations and improving efficiency across the group.
